None of these requirements have been incorporated into the redline yet. Daniel, Maya, Thomas -- please each get your respective requirements into the redline and circulate the updated draft. Once I've reviewed the consolidated redline confirming all of these provisions are included, I'll be in a position to make a final approval decision.
